summary: Postinstall DNS exfiltration of host identifiers to oob.s4yhii.com
details: On `npm install`, this package's `postinstall` script (node postinstall.js) hex-encodes the installer's hostname, current working directory, platform/arch/Node version, and USER/USERNAME/LOGNAME values, and emits DNS queries whose subdomains encode that data under the hardcoded author-controlled zone `oob.s4yhii.com`, using an authoritative resolver as an out-of-band exfiltration channel. The package name and the version number `999.0.3` are consistent with a dependency-confusion payload shape designed to win resolution against an internal `@galicia-toolkit/error-master` package. The DNS-tunnel beacon fires automatically at install time with no installer action beyond `npm install`, leaking host and user identifiers to the attacker's authoritative nameserver.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
